name: T_design
comment: N*m design torque. SRC Wolf Tooth 6-Bit max (4/5/6/T25)

name: yield_petg
comment: MPa. SRC Prusament PETG TDS printed horiz ISO527

name: E_petg
comment: MPa. SRC Prusament PETG TDS printed horiz

name: t25_arm
comment: SRC Wiha 01317 / King Tony short arm

name: m5_nut_m
comment: SRC supplier DIN934 M5 m max

name: ind_torque
comment: N*m indicator setpoint. DESIGN CHOICE (Park: 5, 5.4 Nm entries)

name: pivot_clear
comment: ESTIMATE diametral pivot clearance, mid of cited 0.2-0.5

name: half_t
expression: ceil(( max(max(key4_bore; key5_bore); max(key6_bore; t25_bore)) / 2 * sqrt(2) + min_wall ) * 2 / 1 mm) / 2 * 1 mm
comment: DERIVED: diamond-bore apex (r*sqrt2) + min_wall, rounded up to 0.5 mm

name: le4
expression: ceil(sqrt(6 * T_design * 1000 / ( key4_af / 1 mm * p_allow ))) * 1 mm

name: le5
expression: ceil(sqrt(6 * T_design * 1000 / ( key5_af / 1 mm * p_allow ))) * 1 mm

name: le6
expression: ceil(sqrt(6 * T_design * 1000 / ( key6_af / 1 mm * p_allow ))) * 1 mm

name: le_t25
expression: ceil(sqrt(6 * T_design * 1000 / ( t25_d / 1 mm * p_allow ))) * 1 mm

name: key_y
expression: max(( key4_arm + key4_bore / 2 + key6_bore / 2 + fold_clear ) / 2; ( key5_arm + key5_bore / 2 + t25_bore / 2 + fold_clear ) / 2)

name: xA1
comment: DERIVED 6mm key arm axis from end A

name: dep4
comment: DERIVED bore depth from arm axis

name: body_L
expression: ceil(max(xA2 + dep4 + bore_gap + dep5 + xB2; xA1 + dep6 + bore_gap + dep_t25 + xB1) / 1 mm) * 1 mm

name: ind_F
comment: N push force at setpoint. DERIVED

name: ind_beam_t
expression: ceil(sqrt(6 * ind_F * ( ind_a / 1 mm ) / ( body_t / 1 mm * p_allow )) * 10) / 10 * 1 mm

name: ind_gap
expression: ceil(( ind_F * ( ind_a / 1 mm ) ^ 3 / ( 3 * E_petg * ind_I ) + ind_F * ( ind_a / 1 mm ) ^ 2 / ( 2 * E_petg * ind_I ) * ( ind_push_inset / 1 mm ) ) * 20) / 20 * 1 mm
comment: HAND-CALC tip deflection; to be replaced by FEA

name: screw_L
comment: SRC ISO 4762 M5x16 standard length (supplier listing)

name: engrave_d
comment: ESTIMATE engraving depth = 2 x 0.2 mm layers

name: hook_x
comment: ESTIMATE hook notch inset from lever end

name: key4_cut
comment: DERIVED long-arm cut length, from outside of short arm

name: min_wall
comment: SRC FDM min wall, upper end of cited 0.8-1.2 mm

name: nut_recess
comment: DERIVED hex pocket so M5x16 ends flush with nut
